title: Research without a second progression system

blocks.text: The Research Chamber studies a sample and unlocks the corresponding research group. Unlocks are stored on the server per player or in the configured server-wide shared state. Bookmarks and reading history never count as research.

rows: Open Research using the button in this book to see the sample list and current unlock display.
Place a valid sample in an owned Research Chamber.
Supply the current study cost and wait through its duration. The sample is kept by default; a server option can consume it.
After completion, retry the newly unlocked calculator recipe with the correct family, counts and free result slots.

blocks.text: Mastery records completed Calculator, Scientific, Atomic and Flawless batches. It is informational in this port: reaching a target does not secretly award an item or create a new recipe gate.

Packaged guide prose is public. A reader lock icon cannot make a shipped paragraph secret. Future providers must filter genuinely restricted live information server-side rather than relying on UI hiding.
